items.name: sword_thunk_1
items.text: A metal sword blade slides into a tight stone slot and stops with a hard solid thunk, metal against stone. Short, dry, close-up foley.

items.name: slap_1

items.name: boulder_1
items.text: A big rock slams down onto stone paving with a loud crunchy crack and a heavy thump, bits of gravel scatter. Short, no voices.

items.text: Thirty people in cloaks and armor kneel down at the same time: a wave of rustling cloth, clinking metal and knees touching the ground. No voices, no music.
